title: PROPOSAL (not implemented): approved dialogue clip consumed by Agent-008
description: One record per spoken line. Voice audio is a separately human-approved input. Agent-008 only places it; it never generates, regenerates, retimes by resynthesis, or substitutes dialogue. Missing, unapproved or hash-mismatched dialogue fails closed.

line_index.description: order of the line within the shot's approved voice_lines

voice_asset_id.description: registry id of the human-approved character voice (e.g. VOICE-LUMI-v01), APPROVED/LOCKED

voice_id.description: pinned ElevenLabs voice_id recorded on the voice asset; informational for provenance

dialogue_text.description: exact approved line, character for character

dialogue_text_sha256.description: sha256 of dialogue_text (UTF-8, as in the approved script); must equal the hash of the manifest line

audio_asset_id.description: registry id of the approved dialogue clip, APPROVED/LOCKED

duration_s.description: measured from the file (ffprobe sample count / rate); Agent-008 re-measures and fails on disagreement > 1 sample

end_time_s.description: = start_time_s + duration_s; must be <= shot duration minus tail guard; protected holds accept no dialogue

x-agent008-rules: Fail closed if dialogue_text_sha256 differs from sha256 of the manifest's approved line (no paraphrase can slip in).
Fail closed if the clip, the voice asset or the line is not APPROVED, or if sha256 differs.
Fail closed if lines in one shot overlap, run past the shot end minus tail guard, or land in a protected participation hold.
Never call a TTS provider; a missing clip yields DIALOGUE_NOT_APPROVED, never a generation.
Time-stretching is not allowed by default; any retime is a separately approved edit recorded on the clip.
Captions derive from dialogue_text with start/end from this record (timeline.timed_text_from_slots).
